description: This PHP class defines a data model 'EmployeeLicenseModel' used for serializing employee license information within the OrangeHRM system. It implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits to facilitate serialization of EmployeeLicense entity data, including license number, issue date, expiry date, and related license details.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseModel
classes.description: A PHP model class for serializing EmployeeLicense entities, providing a structured representation for API responses, including license number, issued and expiry dates, and license details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeLicenseModel with an EmployeeLicense entity and configures filters and attribute names for serialization.
